newsitem.title: USA: U of Michigan consumer sentiment Aug final 95.3. [Corrected 14:55 gmt]
newsitem.headline: U of Michigan consumer sentiment Aug final 95.3. [Corrected 14:55 gmt]

text.p: The University of Michigan's final index of consumer sentiment for August rose (corrects from "fell") to 95.3 compared to 94.7 in the final July index, financial market sources said on Friday.
The current conditions component rose to 107.8 in the final August reading from 107.5 in the final July report.
The expectations index rose to 87.3 in the final August reading from 86.5 in final July, the sources added.
The data are released only to paying subscribers.
